name: Buttermilk, cultured, low-fat
source: Proximate composition (per kg): water 900 g, protein 33 g, fat 9 g, ash 7.5 g, carbohydrate by difference 50.5 g, typical of cultured low-fat buttermilk (USDA FoodData Central pattern).
notes: Same conversion method as cow-milk-whole. Buttermilk is the low-fat liquid remaining after butter is churned from cream, so its mineral profile is modelled the same way as milk (calcium- and phosphorus-led ash split).
